title: Apotris
description: A free and multiplatform block stacking game with online multiplayer
long_description:
**Apotris** is a free multiplatform open-source block stacking game! What sets Apotris apart from other block stacking games is its extensive customization options, complemented by ultra-responsive controls that let you execute your moves with precision. With 14 unique game modes and a plethora of settings, you can tailor the game to your preferences, ensuring a fresh and challenging experience every time you play. Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore enthusiast, Apotris has something for everyone. While Apotris was originally designed for Gameboy Advance, it now supports all kinds of platforms, so between the ports and emulation you can play Apotris on almost anything.

The game is still actively maintained and new features are added constantly. If you have any suggestions, want to learn about new features or participate in beta releases, join the Apotris discord server!

### Game-modes:

* **Marathon**: Try to get the best score as the game gets faster and faster
* **Sprint**: Clear lines to reach the goal as fast as possible
* **Dig**: Dig through lines of garbage
* **Ultra**: Get the best score in a limited time
* **Blitz**: Get the best score in a limited time while the game gets faster and faster
* **Combo**: Aim for the most consecutive clears in a 4-wide well
* **Survival**: Survive as long as possible while garbage rises from below
* **Classic**: Old school stacking mechanics
* **Master**: Get the highest Grade while the game gets aggressively faster
* **Death**: Try to survive at brutal speeds
* **Zen**: The goal is to relax...
* **Multiplayer Battle**: Battle with up to 5 players online on PC, Portmaster, 3DS, and Android with crossplay, or through the Link Cable or Wireless Adapter on GBA
* **CPU Battle**: Go against an AI opponent
* **Training**: Try out new strategies or improve your playing using the included Finesse Trainer

update_notes_md:
## v4.2.0

If you are updating from a previous version, make sure to backup your save first!

- New Port:
  - Android, including customizable on-screen controls
- Added Online multiplayer on PC/Portmaster/3DS/Android (mostly by Heni)
  - Crossplay is supported
  - Play with friends or randoms online
  - Will be further improved with modes, ranked queue, better social options, and more in a future update!
- Expanded multiplayer lobbies to support 5 players at once (GBA too!) (by Heni)
- Added rounds to multiplayer matches, with selectable target (first to 3, 5, or 7 wins)
- Improved incoming attacks bar to show separate attacks and highlight the next attack
- Added sound effects for received and sent attacks
- Added Cascade submode to Marathon and Zen (each tetromino falls separately in the stack)
- Added Tower submode to Marathon and Zen (instead of clearing lines, you fill them! You lose if you leave a hole) (by Alexis Moroz)
- Added Zone submode to Zen
- Improved BARS and added SDRS rotation systems (by CreepercraftT99)
- Added longer and more reliable replays (hopefully fixed crashes for long replays)
- Replay statistics are now preserved when viewing an interrupted replay
- Added custom skin import and export on PC and other supported platforms
  - Custom skins are automatically stored and loaded from the /skins folder
- Added support for more music formats on PC/Portmaster (mp3, ogg, flac, wav) and 3DS (.ogg, .opus, mp3) (3DS support by [Alvin](https://github.com/alvinhochun))
- Song list menu now shows song names on PC and 3DS (by [Alvin](https://github.com/alvinhochun))
- Added smooth falling-piece gravity option
- Added automatic pause when the game's window loses focus on PC
- Added lifetime Zen line statistics
- Added Sonic Drop Handling Options (changes hard drop so it doesn't lock the piece after dropping, and soft drop so it locks the piece after dropping)
- Changed pro mode so it doesn't give S, Z, or O tetrominos as the first piece in Sprint
- Added in-game battery indicator option for devices with batteries (PC, Portmaster, Linux)
- Added Place Effect feature to non-GBA/3DS platforms
- Improved skip song feature
- (Portmaster) Added button mapping support for L2/R2 buttons
- (Portmaster) Fixed being able to activate zone with no meter
- (PC) Fixed rumble starting and never stopping if rumble was set to OFF
- (GBA) Added autosleep and new sleep/wake options (by nullstalgia)
- (GBA) Added improved rumble effects and more rumble settings (by nullstalgia)
- (Linux) Added easier installation and desktop menu integration (.desktop file with install script, .AppImage) (partially by dogbolt_system)
- (Linux) Changed savefile storage location to fit Linux standards (by bizmyth)
